changeSet.author: qodiriy
changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS integration.integration_credential ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4() NOT NULL, provider VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, login TEXT NOT NULL, password TEXT NOT NULL, base_url TEXT, deleted BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE NOT NULL, created_date TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, last_modified_date TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP );
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_integration_credential_provider_active ON integration.integration_credential (provider) WHERE deleted = false;

changeSet.author: qodiriy
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS integration.scoring_history ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4() NOT NULL, user_id UUID, card_id UUID, created_at TIMESTAMP, type TEXT, response JSONB, uzcard JSONB, humo JSONB, plum_scoring_id INTEGER, status TEXT );

changeSet.author: qodiriy
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO integration.integration_credential (id, provider, login, password, base_url, deleted, created_date, last_modified_date) SELECT id, provider, login, password, base_url, deleted, created_date, last_modified_date FROM billing.integration_credential ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING;
